paper.title_en: Connecting High-Twist Expansion and Color Glass Condensate Dynamics
paper.abstract_en: The high-twist (HT) expansion and the Color Glass Condensate (CGC) describe nuclear multiple scattering in complementary kinematic regimes. For direct-photon production in proton-nucleus collisions, we formulate an arbitrary-order multiple-scattering master expression that includes photon emission before, between, or after the ordered quark scatterings in the amplitude and its conjugate. In the high-energy limit, resumming multiple scatterings to all orders recovers the CGC Wilson-line dipole result. However, the naive power expansion of the eikonal CGC result reproduces the leading twist but only part of the twist-four contribution obtained in the HT expansion. Including longitudinal sub-eikonal phases and Landau-Pomeranchuk-Migdal interference restores the CGC-HT correspondence through twist-4.
